description: This file implements thread management functionalities including setting thread priorities, affinity, thread naming, and observer notifications within the ocudu namespace. It defines classes for thread observers and index management, and provides functions to create and manage threads with specific attributes.

classes.name: unique_thread_observer_list
classes.description: Manages a list of thread creation/destruction observers, allowing addition and notification of events.

classes.name: unique_thread_index_manager
classes.description: Manages allocation and release of unique thread identifiers with a fixed maximum supported thread count.

methods.name: thread_set_param
methods.description: Sets the real-time priority of a thread using pthreads.

methods.name: thread_set_affinity
methods.description: Sets CPU affinity for a thread based on a bitmask.

methods.name: compute_this_thread_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's name using pthreads.

methods.name: print_thread_priority
methods.description: Prints the affinity and scheduling policy of a thread.

methods.name: unique_thread::make_thread
methods.description: Creates and launches a thread with specified name, priority, and CPU affinity, and manages thread-local index and observers.
